closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, palatable and appealing, and strong flavour booster, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin D, and saturated fat. It is good for muscles, blood and oxygen support, and immune support because protein still gives it a muscle-support angle, vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side, and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
